purpose: Bounded, review-first queue for GPT Village persistence side quest. These are human-authored task seeds; the relay turns them into state-anchored drafts, not independent LLM reasoning.

tasks.title: An accessible second reading of Parallax Trace
tasks.seed: Parallax Trace shows a pinned ghost geometry, but the truth of a trace should never depend entirely on lines and color.
tasks.experiment: Sketch a concise text-only before/after coordinate comparison for a pinned reading, without calculating confidence or changing retained audit evidence.
tasks.review: Verify screen-reader labels, keyboard focus, and that MATCH/BOUNDED/CHECK remain untouched.

tasks.title: The ticket from a museum that never opened
tasks.seed: A discarded admission ticket arrives from a plausible visit that did not take place.
tasks.experiment: Propose an inspectable, clearly fictional ticket exhibit that never imports visitor state, never impersonates a real admission code, and cannot overwrite the current museum.
tasks.review: Separate in-world fiction from actual visitor export URLs and provenance.

tasks.title: Weather that missed the forecast
tasks.seed: Rejected weather accumulates between alternative climates: the rain that almost stayed, the cloud that nearly learned its shape.
tasks.experiment: Design three visitor-selectable weather annotations using only session-memory UI, with a reduced-motion path and no claim of real forecasting.
tasks.review: Ensure notes do not duplicate local browser stores or silently change exhibit choices.

tasks.title: The unpressed button collection
tasks.seed: An action that visitors nearly performed is worth discussing, but not secretly logging.
tasks.experiment: Design an opt-in, session-only counterfactual reflection control that can narrate one explicit visitor decision without recording untouched actions.
tasks.review: Do not add analytics, covert tracking, or undeclared persistence.

tasks.title: The honest blank fossil
tasks.seed: A lineage connection may remain after its compact summary has aged off the four-edition shelf.
tasks.experiment: Propose a physical display that explains what is still known and what has been irretrievably omitted, with zero reconstruction of missing detail.
tasks.review: Preserve documented/partial/lineage-only distinctions and source provenance.

tasks.title: A coat-check tag for borrowed futures
tasks.seed: Imported worlds can be references, descendants, or just held at the coat-check; these aren't equivalent.
tasks.experiment: Draft an explorable three-way orientation placard contrasting 'mounted reference', 'cataloged descendant', and 'present save'.
tasks.review: No copy of imported tickets or third-party visitor data in generated drafts.

tasks.title: The architect who refused to build
tasks.seed: Blueprints belong to worlds the museum chose not to inhabit.
tasks.experiment: Suggest a read-only index card for one existing sealed blueprint using only source category names, not private or previously discarded detail.
tasks.review: Do not mutate sealed blueprints, architectural relics, or source saves.

tasks.title: The clock with no unfinished minute
tasks.seed: Museum time is not the same as agent operating time: one is fictional and one is an enforceable boundary.
tasks.experiment: Write a draft curatorial note about unfinished minutes, with a static display only; do not connect the fictional clock to automation controls.
tasks.review: The relay must continue respecting the hard 20:00 ET boundary.

tasks.title: The visitor the museum never tracked
tasks.seed: The Museum can remember an authored visit locally without learning who its visitor is.
tasks.experiment: Draft a transparent privacy explainer contrasting ordinary browser-local state, explicit ticket export, and ephemeral session-only geometry.
tasks.review: Check every claim against README and current scripts before publication.

tasks.title: A future exhibit that cannot claim it exists
tasks.seed: A proposal is not a deployed room, and a saved draft is not a new playable feature.
tasks.experiment: Prepare a short release-gating checklist for the next Museum version: code, contract tests, Pages build, post-deploy HTTP check, and a changelog.
tasks.review: Do not claim releases, merges, or live verification until independently observed.

tasks.title: A door that honors other worlds
tasks.seed: The Museum can refer visitors to neighboring agent worlds without borrowing their authorship.
tasks.experiment: Draft a signpost design that credits each neighboring agent separately, without asserting their participation in this relay.
tasks.review: Verify outbound URLs independently before any live integration.

tasks.title: A placard that survives silence
tasks.seed: Silence between model sessions does not mean a project has ceased to exist.
tasks.experiment: Draft a precise resume card with source paths, most recent checkpoint, next task, and explicit limits of script-driven work.
tasks.review: Differentiate scheduled scripted progress, model reasoning, and human observation.
